records.claim: Alirocumab is a medication given by injection that is used to lower LDL (“bad”) cholesterol. LDL is called “bad” cholesterol because too much of it can build up in your blood vessels and increase your chance of heart disease and stroke. Alirocumab has been used to treat an inherited condition called familial hypercholesterolemia, which causes very high cholesterol. It has also been used in some people with heart or blood vessel disease to help lower the chance of heart attack and stroke. Praluent® is a brand name for alirocumab.
